description: 행정안전부_지방재정365_공공시설운영현황(2021년) [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 행정안전부. 지방자치단체가 관리하고있는 공공시설물에 대한 운영현황에 대한 정보로서 2021년도 회계연도의 정보입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 행정안전부. Its tags are 결산, 재정성과평가, 공공시설운영현황, 공공시설물, 연간이용인원. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-05-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
